en:
When you reach 1e1,425,000 polynomial power, you can unlock Y-Polynomials.
The first Y-Polynomial is y3, which produces Y-Polynomial Power, which gives an exponent to Polynomial efficiencies.
Y-Polynomials work similarly to Polynomials, with each tier costing and producing the tier before it.
The efficiency of a Y-Polynomial doubles per purchase, until it reaches 1e9, which then it's softcapped.
Additionally, Y-Polynomials are normally not affected by global speed.

Y-Polynomial Power Effect Formula: (log10(power + 1)0.75 / 500) + 1, hardcaps at 1.58
zh:
当你达到 1e1,425,000 多项式能量时，即可解锁 Y-多项式。
第一个 Y-多项式是 y3，它产出 Y-多项式能量，后者为多项式效率提供指数。
Y-多项式的运作方式与多项式类似，每一层都消耗并产出前一层。
Y-多项式的效率每次购买都会翻倍，直到达到 1e9，之后将受到软上限限制。
此外，Y-多项式通常不受全局速度影响。

Y-多项式能量效果公式： (log10(power + 1)0.75 / 500) + 1，硬上限为 1.58

en: You may know that the formula for the volume of a cylinder is V = πr<sup>2</sup>h. However, there may be some more rules for cylinders that you aren't familiar with. 1) A cylinder should not be assumed to be anything else. It's a cylinder, plain and simple. 2) Cylinders have nothing to do with urination. 3) When a cylinder is attached to a larger structure, please be especially careful when handling it. 4) Do not damage the cylinder. It is imperative that the cylinder and/or any objects connected to it remain unharmed. 5) Do not be alarmed if the cylinder expands in size. 6) When inserting the cylinder into a larger object, it may expand significantly due to change in temperature. Please remain calm if this happens. 7) If the cylinder hasn't changed size in approximately 3 hours, you may have a problem. 8) It's not tiny, it's an above average sized cylinder.
zh: 你可能知道圆柱体积公式是 V = πr<sup>2</sup>h。不过，关于圆柱可能还有一些你不熟悉的规则。1) 不要把圆柱当成别的东西。它就是圆柱，简单明了。2) 圆柱与排尿无关。3) 当圆柱连接到更大的结构上时，请务必小心操作。4) 不要损坏圆柱。圆柱和/或与之相连的任何物体必须保持完好，这点至关重要。5) 如果圆柱体积变大，不必惊慌。6) 将圆柱插入更大的物体时，它可能因温度变化而显著膨胀。如果发生这种情况，请保持冷静。7) 如果圆柱在大约 3 小时内没有变化，那你可能有问题了。8) 它不算小，它是一个高于平均尺寸的圆柱。
